title: A Cipher for the Cover
author: Rafael Montrose
blurb: Rafael Kavanagh, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
